name: UT Okta
description: Unit tests of every Okta command against the local stand-in (made-up records, made-up token from the vault): each case shows the command in use and checks its result.

variables.name: ut_dir
variables.description: Folder with the test data (files, workbooks, fixtures).

variables.name: standin_url
variables.description: Address of the local stand-in that imitates outside services.

variables.name: ut_report
variables.description: One line per case: PASS or FAIL, the command and the case.

args.text: Unit tests of every Okta command against the local stand-in (made-up records, made-up token from the vault): each case shows the command in use and checks its result.

args.text: Connect keeps the Okta address and API token as the Okta session, so the next steps leave them empty. Checks a step without its own address then reads Ann's record.
